part.text:
Fixed `WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor` so Peon nodes no longer require `IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider`.

- Middle Manager uses `WorkerTaskCountStatsProvider`
- Indexer uses `IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider`
- Peon/other roles produce no task-count metrics instead of failing injection

Changed `server/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/server/metrics/WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor.java` and verified:
- `WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitorTest` — 4 passed
- `MetricsModuleTest` — 10 passed
